records.key: How many times larger than the canvas the box draws its region. The mouse wheel changes it while the magnifier is on. It changes only what you see: the model always segments the region at the image's own resolution.
records.source: How many times larger than the canvas the box draws its region. The mouse wheel changes it while the magnifier is on. It changes only what you see: the model always segments the region at the image's own resolution.
records.translation: 框中区域相对画布放大的倍数。放大镜开启时可用鼠标滚轮调整。它只改变你看到的内容：模型始终按图像自身的分辨率分割该区域。

records.key: How readily an object is accepted. Raise it to take in dimmer or less certain objects, lower it to keep only clear ones; 0 is each model's own default. For Cellpose it is the cell probability threshold with the sign reversed, so a sensitivity of 1.5 is a threshold of -1.5.
records.source: How readily an object is accepted. Raise it to take in dimmer or less certain objects, lower it to keep only clear ones; 0 is each model's own default. For Cellpose it is the cell probability threshold with the sign reversed, so a sensitivity of 1.5 is a threshold of -1.5.
records.translation: 对象被接受的难易程度。调高可纳入更暗或不太确定的对象，调低则只保留清晰的对象；0 为各模型自身的默认值。对于 Cellpose，它是符号取反的细胞概率阈值，因此灵敏度 1.5 对应阈值 -1.5。

records.key: Magnifier off. The objects it added stay in the mask.
records.source: Magnifier off. The objects it added stay in the mask.
records.translation: 放大镜已关闭。它添加的对象仍保留在掩膜中。

records.key: Magnifier on: a click adds the objects outlined in the box; the mouse wheel changes its zoom.
records.source: Magnifier on: a click adds the objects outlined in the box; the mouse wheel changes its zoom.
records.translation: 放大镜已开启：单击会添加框中勾勒出的对象；鼠标滚轮可调整其缩放。

records.key: Magnifier: nothing to add — the box outlines no object, or every object it outlines overlaps one already in the mask.
records.source: Magnifier: nothing to add — the box outlines no object, or every object it outlines overlaps one already in the mask.
records.translation: 放大镜：没有可添加的内容 — 框中没有勾勒出对象，或者勾勒出的每个对象都与掩膜中已有的对象重叠。

records.key: What a new object does where the mask already has an object. Clip keeps only its unlabelled pixels, so no existing object loses a pixel. Skip leaves out any object that touches an existing one. Replace lets the new object take every pixel it covers.
records.source: What a new object does where the mask already has an object. Clip keeps only its unlabelled pixels, so no existing object loses a pixel. Skip leaves out any object that touches an existing one. Replace lets the new object take every pixel it covers.
records.translation: 新对象在掩膜已有对象的位置如何处理。裁剪只保留它未标记的像素，因此现有对象不会失去任何像素。跳过会舍弃任何接触现有对象的对象。替换让新对象占据它覆盖的每个像素。

records.key: Which model segments the region in the box. Classical thresholds the region at Otsu's level and splits touching objects with a watershed; it needs nothing installed, follows the Bright switch and the Min area box under Object operations, and runs whenever a model cannot be loaded. Cellpose uses the model and diameter set in the Cellpose-SAM settings and is slow without a GPU.
records.source: Which model segments the region in the box. Classical thresholds the region at Otsu's level and splits touching objects with a watershed; it needs nothing installed, follows the Bright switch and the Min area box under Object operations, and runs whenever a model cannot be loaded. Cellpose uses the model and diameter set in the Cellpose-SAM settings and is slow without a GPU.
records.translation: 由哪个模型分割框中的区域。传统方法按 Otsu 阈值对区域进行阈值分割，并用分水岭分开相互接触的对象；它无需安装任何东西，遵循 对象操作 下的 明亮 开关和 Min area 框，并在无法加载模型时运行。Cellpose 使用 Cellpose-SAM 设置中的模型和直径，没有 GPU 时速度较慢。
